resources.title: HTTP & AI Provider Error Code Reference
resources.description: Lesson 3's five HTTP method/status-code tables plus Lesson 14's real Anthropic error shape and status codes (400-529), combined on one page with a single retry-or-don't column — the exact lookup you need mid-build when a call fails and you need to know, in one glance, whether that specific status code is worth retrying.

resources.title: JSON Schema & Tool-Calling Templates
resources.description: Four real, ready-to-adapt JSON Schema templates — a generic structured-output object schema (Lesson 8's four keywords), the course's own get_weather tool definition (Lesson 13), a completed get_stock_price tool answering Lesson 13's own lab prompt, and a minimal multi-tool array shape — so you can copy a working schema instead of writing one from a blank file.

resources.title: AI Provider API Field Cheat Sheet
resources.description: A single-page lookup covering the Anthropic-vs-OpenAI-style field name differences from Lesson 11 (reply text, stop reason, token usage), the real rate-limit headers and token-bucket behavior from Lesson 19, and the cursor-based pagination loop shape from Lesson 15 — the three references reached for most often while actually writing client code.
